top_paper.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
top_paper.summary: SpatialScout evaluates vision-language agents on active 3D object mapping, revealing major gaps in precise metric map construction.

papers.title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
papers.summary: SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into skeleton-guided kinematic and residual components to improve controllable robot world modeling and motion transfer.

papers.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
papers.summary: Policy-Mask learns a budget-conditioned selection policy over diffusion timesteps, network blocks, and channels to extract compact, task-optimal features for discriminative vision tasks.

papers.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
papers.summary: Researchers introduce a benchmark and evaluation framework for video-centered deep research agents that synthesize external evidence into interactive reports linked to video moments.

papers.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
papers.summary: SCOPE compiles compound policies into optimized neural-symbolic programs that achieve high accuracy, stability, and interpretability on inexpensive models.

papers.title: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
papers.summary: Foundation4D is a unified feed-forward model that jointly estimates geometry, detects objects, predicts semantic occupancy, and reconstructs Gaussians from multi-camera driving video, achieving state-of-the-art results across several benchmarks.

papers.title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
papers.summary: LaLa-World is a language-conditioned latent world model that jointly learns from diverse simulation, robot, and video data to enable efficient model-predictive planning and policy initialization.

papers.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
papers.summary: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning enables video diffusion transformers to leverage multimodal language model representations for sparse temporal inference and factor-aware cinematic control through staged grounding and optimization.

papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.summary: This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.

papers.title: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
papers.summary: Shared meta-experts across layers reduce redundancy and improve efficiency compared to layer-specific local experts in mixture-of-experts models.

papers.title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
papers.summary: Code2Video-Compass is a benchmark evaluating multimodal language models on code-based video generation across text, image, and video inputs, revealing significant challenges in complex dynamic and state-dependent tasks.

papers.title: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
papers.summary: MMedAgent-Plus is a multimodal medical agent that coordinates specialist AI models via a vision-language planner to execute multi-step clinical analyses with high accuracy and faithful synthesis.

papers.title: Same Simulation, Different Evidence: Where Retrieved Tool Output Costs LLM Agents Accuracy
papers.summary: Agent harnesses that retrieve long simulator outputs from files rather than including them in context cause GPT models to substitute their own approximations for authoritative results, reducing accuracy despite correct underlying computations.

papers.title: Bridged Self-Distillation for On-Policy Learning
papers.summary: Bridged Self-Distillation unifies on-policy reasoning transfer from any teacher by using privileged reasoning traces to score student rollouts and guide updates via outcome verification.

papers.title: Stratified Sparse Attention: Reducing the Sparse-to-Dense Gap at Extreme Sparsity
papers.summary: Stratified Sparse Attention unifies deterministic retrieval and score-guided sampling to recover attention mass, improving long-context inference accuracy and speed across multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: StyleStream 2.0: Fast and Controllable Streaming Voice Style Conversion
papers.summary: StyleStream 2.0 improves streaming voice conversion with lower latency via a few-step MeanFlow model and enables text-based voice design and editing through a unified flow matching model.

papers.title: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
papers.summary: FrontierCS 2 evaluates LLM agents on open-ended computer science R&D tasks using hidden evaluation suites and reveals that even the best agents pass only about half of tasks.

papers.title: Language Models Learn to Improve Language Models
papers.summary: LM2LM uses a frozen research world model to provide scalable reinforcement learning rewards for generating language model improvements, maintaining reliability through periodic real execution and outperforming larger baselines at lower cost.

papers.title: VerifierBench: Benchmarking the Generation of Executable Verifiers for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Agents generate executable verifiers to validate outputs, but these verifiers often wrongly reject valid solutions due to hidden assumptions, prompting recommendations to test acceptance of diverse correct answers.

papers.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Looping early Transformer layers improves training and inference efficiency of uniform diffusion language models without altering their objective or sampler.

papers.title: RoboCasa-Shift: Stage-Aware Robustness Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Household Manipulation
papers.summary: RoboCasa-Shift evaluates vision-language-action robustness through paired rollouts and stage-aware diagnostics, revealing that failure patterns vary by shift factor and task rather than degrading uniformly.

papers.title: Exploring The Empirical Privacy Landscape of Synthetic Data
papers.summary: Privacy-aware rewriting of synthetic medical records improves privacy protection with less capability loss than direct fine-tuning or DP-SGD, offering a favorable trade-off for sensitive data.

papers.title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
papers.summary: Diffusion language model agents can exchange compressed continuous hidden messages that causally affect reasoning, with the timing of transfer sometimes outweighing repeated exchanges.

papers.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: DiffResearch replaces autoregressive backbones with diffusion language models in multi-agent deep research, achieving large latency reductions and improved report quality via iterative planning and early subquery extraction.

papers.title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
papers.summary: Quant-Arena benchmarks end-to-end quantitative research by evaluating whether language models can build trading strategies on historical A-share data that remain profitable in a sealed future year.

papers.title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
papers.summary: ToM2Vec learns abstract partner-state representations via continuous latent reasoning tokens to improve multi-agent collaboration across diverse settings.

papers.title: Design Anything, Design at Scale
papers.summary: Design Anything uses an intent-execution graph and task contracts to maintain design alignment across long projects, improving constraint satisfaction and deliverable completeness over baseline agents.

papers.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
papers.summary: LASAGNA evaluates composed RAG pipelines across scales and finds that isolated technique gains do not reliably predict combined retrieval quality, faithfulness, or large-corpus performance.

papers.title: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
papers.summary: Most proposed reinforcement learning training methods for language models are not adopted by open-source frameworks, with adoption rates remaining low despite growing publication volumes.

papers.title: WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State
papers.summary: WorldStream is an open-ended 3D world model that continuously expands terrain, processes language commands, and preserves edits through hierarchical planning and streaming compilation.

papers.summary: SpatialScout evaluates vision-language agents on active 3D object mapping, revealing major gaps in precise metric map construction.
